# Purpose
This file records third-party packages used by the project and the license text for each package. It lists package names, versions, license types, repository links, homepages, authors, and copyright notices, so the codebase can track legal terms for included dependencies. The content covers UI libraries, state management tools, routing tools, charting tools, utility packages, and browser support packages, which shows that it supports dependency compliance across the application. It is used as a software bill of materials and as a license reference for distribution and review.
